name: Quilt Blocks
what: A calm, ad-supported Android block puzzle where players fit dyed-cloth patches onto an 8×8 board drawn like a hand-stitched kantha quilt.
hard_part: Built on a shared Flutter game kit that handles AdMob consent (UMP), capped interstitials (never on launch, at least 90 s apart), opt-in rewarded ads and haptics, so each new game ships with the same ad rules.
facts: 8×8 board, three pieces at a time, rows and columns clear together
No timer, no energy, no lives
Works fully offline and resumes mid-game
Listed in 177 countries on the closed track
